subject: SCIENCE
title: Sound Starts with Vibrations
objective: Relate sound to vibration and practice hearing safety.
introduction: Sound begins with vibration and travels through a medium. Loud or prolonged sound can harm hearing. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: Something you hear with your ears.
The sense that lets us listen with our ears.
A fast back-and-forth movement that makes sound.

items.prompt: Which statement best matches “Sound Starts with Vibrations”?

options.text: Sound begins with vibration and travels through a medium. Loud or prolonged sound can harm hearing.
